$Comment: The introduction to mastery: the Adventurer's Guide has been met in the Forgotten Temple, and
the trainer is standing a few paces away across the same landing. The quest exists to make the
player look up and notice them.
It is taken automatically the moment the temple meeting is finished, so it lands on the tracker
while the player is still standing down there, pointing at somebody in the same room.
The step names the trainer's role id. That placement authors no Identity.NpcId, so the character
IS the role, and any other standing of Mmo_Mastery_Trainer credits the step just as well. There
is no TurnInId, so the quest finishes on the conversation itself rather than on a walk back; the
reward sits in the Claim bucket and waits in the quest log until the player collects it, which
they can do from the trainer's own quest list.
A talk step is credited by a MarkTalked beat inside the conversation, never by pressing F, so
the trainer's dialogue carries one on the line the player picks. Re-point the step and that beat
One mastery point is deliberate: it is enough to spend on the screen the quest just introduced,
so the first visit is not a locked door. Edit Rewards to re-tune it.
Requires.Quests names a quest the mod jar ships, which is what chains this pack onto the end of
the starter run; without the jar's temple quest finished the trainer simply has nothing to say.
The feature factor keeps the quest out of the log on a server with mastery switched off, where
the trainer never appears at all.
